raw_text: Cannot reach Ollama from the Tailscale mesh. curl http://100.79.30.90:11434/api/tags and curl http://100.68.225.41:11434/api/tags both return 'connection refused' from DEBIAN13 and from a Tailscale laptop. Ollama on the Mac Mini only binds to the WireGuard interface (OLLAMA_HOST=10.10.10.2:11434, wg0 subnet 10.10.10.0/24). The working path is an SSH local-forward through the controller: ssh -L 11434:10.10.10.2:11434 ferdi@100.94.99.125 (ED25519 key required, key-only auth). Closing the SSH session kills generation mid-run.

Grafana shows the Loki datasource as unreachable — Explore with the Loki data source returns 502/Bad Gateway, and queries like {namespace="monitoring"} fail. Loki endpoint http://loki.monitoring.svc:3100 is not responding; the StatefulSet pod is not Ready. Promtail DaemonSet is shipping but the push endpoint /loki/api/v1/push times out. No SOP currently exists for this failure mode.

nginx bind failed — the nginx container exits immediately on startup with 'bind() to 0.0.0.0:80 failed (98: Address already in use)'. Port 80 on the host is occupied by another process/container. Container fails to start, docker logs show the bind error.

csi-nfs-controller snapshotter sidecar is flooding stderr with repeated reflector errors: 'Failed to watch' err='failed to list *v1.VolumeSnapshotClass: the server could not find the requested resource (get volumesnapshotclasses.snapshot.storage.k8s.io)' and the same for *v1.VolumeSnapshotContent (volumesnapshotcontents.snapshot.storage.k8s.io). Errors repeat every few seconds from pod csi-nfs-controller-7c9bdd7bdc-529hh on worker-1, namespace kube-system, app csi-driver-nfs. The snapshot.storage.k8s.io CRDs are not installed on the cluster, so the external-snapshotter informers cannot list/watch.
